title: Superpowers Nobody Asked For: So you have useless superpower. It's terminal.
caption:
So you have useless superpower. It's terminal.

This message has been brought to you by experience:
1️⃣ The Toaster Prophecy — You can predict which pop-tart will land face-down with 100% accuracy. No casino will take your calls.
2️⃣ The Lyrics Time Machine — Cannot recall a single birthday date, but every 2004 jingle arrives fully mastered, at 3am, uninvited.
3️⃣ The Sneak Snack — The kitchen floor knows your 2am route by sound alone. One creak and everyone wakes up. Stealth: legendary.
4️⃣ The Plot Spoiler — You know the twist in minute 3. You tell nobody. You watch everyone else discover it and feel like a wizard.

Repost before someone you know gets exposed.
